import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = """sepal_length,sepal_width,petal_length,petal_width,species
5.1,3.5,1.4,0.2,setosa
4.9,3.0,1.4,0.2,setosa
4.7,3.2,1.3,0.2,setosa
4.6,3.1,1.5,0.2,setosa
5.0,3.6,1.4,0.2,setosa"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset Visualization', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Scatter plot: Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
axes[0, 0].scatter(df['sepal_length'], df['sepal_width'], c='steelblue', s=100, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sepal Length vs Sepal Width')
axes[0, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Scatter plot: Petal Length vs Petal Width
axes[0, 1].scatter(df['petal_length'], df['petal_width'], c='coral', s=100, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Petal Length vs Petal Width')
axes[0, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Bar plot: Average measurements
measurements = ['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width']
averages = df[measurements].mean()
colors = ['steelblue', 'lightblue', 'coral', 'lightsalmon']
axes[1, 0].bar(range(len(measurements)), averages, color=colors, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(len(measurements)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(['Sepal\nLength', 'Sepal\nWidth', 'Petal\nLength', 'Petal\nWidth'], fontsize=9)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Average (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Average Measurements')
axes[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Box plot: Distribution of all measurements
df_melted = df[measurements].melt(var_name='Measurement', value_name='Value')
bp = axes[1, 1].boxplot([df[col] for col in measurements], labels=['Sepal\nLength', 'Sepal\nWidth', 'Petal\nLength', 'Petal\nWidth'], 
                         patch_artist=True, showmeans=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Distribution of Measurements')
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
